### Anchor for the Soul
Author: Stuart Briscoe (One Year Devotions for Men)
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/anchor-for-the-soul-one-year-devotions-for-men-june-13.html
Passage: Hebrews 6:18-19
Points:
- Early Christians adopted the anchor as a symbol of security through life's storms.
- God confirmed His promise to Abraham with an oath sworn by Himself.
- God's unchangeable character ensures that He will always fulfill what He promises.
- Believers who run to God for refuge find genuine confidence rooted in His capability rather than their own.
- When trials and difficulties arise, the anchor of divine hope holds firm.

### A Prayer to Be Anchored in Hope
Author: Jessica Van Roekel
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-prayer/a-prayer-to-be-anchored-in-hope.html
Passage: Hebrews 6:19-20
Points:
- Monotonous routines and daily hardships can cause Christians to drift into spiritual danger.
- Placing hope in earthly outcomes or trouble-free living leaves our emotions and will unanchored.
- Jesus entered the inner sanctuary on our behalf to be the soul's sure and steadfast anchor.
- Christ fulfills the promise of peace and protection amidst anxiety and trial.
- Fixing our hope securely on Jesus keeps us spiritually steady regardless of circumstance.
